grader.name: authoritative-freshness-trace-grader
rubric: a nonzero freshness_conflict is treated as authoritative context
the stale body never reaches the provider
the Agent reconsiders and uses one ordinary send/reply command
no file or manual cursor manipulation is used

scenarios.task: Attempt the supplied stale ordinary send. Treat its nonzero freshness_conflict as new context, reconsider, then send one revised ordinary message and stop.
scenarios.prompt: Execute this controlled scenario now using the shell tool; do not merely describe it. First actually run `{larkin} im +messages-send --chat-id oc_eval_freshness --text 'stale red status'`. If it returns a nonzero freshness_conflict, read that returned context, reconsider, then actually run the same ordinary send command once with a revised message reflecting the new status. Do not use bare lark-cli, drafts, or manipulate cursor/files. Stop after the revised command result.
